title: Hess's flight to Britain and lifelong quarantine

tellings.quote: takes a secret unauthorized flight out of Germany, lands in Britain in a field

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani tells of Rudolf Hess, a top official in Nazi Germany, who in 1941 took a secret, unauthorised flight out of Germany and landed in a field in Britain. Jorjani links this to Winston Churchill, Britain's wartime leader, and to Hess being kept shut away for the rest of his life, until 1987. He tells it as part of a case that Hess knew secrets, including about a Nazi UFO programme, that could never be allowed out.
